caption:
healthy is the new luxury, I do not make the rules

#wellness #healthylifestyle #routine

slides.text:
Kinda chic to be
the healthy friend

slides.bg: a chic cafe table by the window with a glass bottle of sparkling water, a lemon slice in a tumbler and sunglasses beside it, soft afternoon light, no people
slides.text:
Kinda chic to order
water first

Kinda chic to leave
the party by eleven

Kinda chic to walk
instead of scroll

Kinda chic to cook
your own dinner

Kinda chic to know
your protein number

slides.bg: a bright calm bedroom at night seen from the doorway — a made bed with white linen, a small warm lamp glowing on the nightstand, a book and a sleep mask on the duvet, cozy and inviting, no people
slides.text:
Kinda chic to be
in bed by ten

slides.heading: Kinda chic to have SOMA
slides.body: It reads your wearables and quietly plans your day around your body — like a very good assistant
